seed_meaning: same frozen A-selected E1/E2 P0; common deterministic optimizer gradient subsampling schedule
renderer: NVlabs/nvdiffrast 253ac4fcea7de5f396371124af597e6cc957bfae; CUDA; actual triangle silhouettes. Native axial first-depth via Open3D face selection and differentiable exact ray/triangle plane.

loss.mask: balanced squared foreground fraction residual plus contour-distance-weighted silhouette residual; all source pixels pooled with conditional Ring-known mass
loss.depth: native axial pair differences; censored rows unknown, never zero-as-valid; fixed denominator and coverage guard
loss.H_definition: bounded closest-visible-triangle distance to same HERO source; not independent of D
loss.unknown: 4x P0 displacement regularization on initially unobserved vertices; identical all arms

optimizer.method: Adam proposal with exact accepted-state rollback; lr in coefficient mm

trust.coverage_relative_to: both P0 and last accepted per-source
trust.ring_penetration: P0 collisions explicitly reported; allow no deeper existing penetration and no new vertex penetration; triangle collision proxy separately reported; cannot certify all continuous contacts
trust.self_intersection: non-adjacent triangle intersection test at accepted candidates

gate.single_view: allow with explicit low-confidence label; same unknown prior all arms

base: OFF all scenes: no currently qualified same-coordinate background/source chain; never Ring plane
stopping: fixed budget; retain last safe geometry even if rejected; hard coordinate/numerical/intersection failures stop affected arm only
comparison: primary candidate-matched; supplemental count-matched only posthoc counts, frequency prefix, no B selection
